clarification_1410: PS5 firmware 26.06-14.10.00 (2026-10-01) is not a PS4 firmware; do not confuse 14.10 with PS4 14.00.
summary: Community research reports a working browser userland chain on PS4 14.00, but no public sandbox escape or kernel primitive. A 14.00 PUP can be decrypted with a 13.52 jailbroken console. The missing link is a public/reproducible kernel primitive.
